comparison.objective: Steady a light printer while pulling its magnetically caught door fully open; candidate commissions a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, catch breakaway, and hinged-door motion versus precision hex-key use, collar adjustment, torque control, and dynamic testing.
comparison.success_condition: Door remains at its open stop without printer displacement or protected-part contact versus repeated acceptable damper stops. No separate specs or exact displacement thresholds are supplied.
comparison.reason: Shared bimanual counterforce is generic; the mechanisms and measured outcomes differ.
